exposure: umbilical artery (UA) Doppler flow velocity and waveform indices
middle cerebral artery (MCA) Doppler flow velocity and waveform indices
cohort: 100 pregnant women, 50 with FGR (25 with abnormal Doppler and 25 with normal Doppler) and 50 without FGR (all with normal Doppler).
finding: Abnormal UA and MCA Doppler indices are significantly associated with operative abdominal deliveries, oligohydramnios, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Operative delivery rates were significantly higher in the FGR group with abnormal Doppler (88%) compared to the FGR group with normal Doppler (36%) and the non-FGR group (24%).
birth_weight: 1.96 +/- 0.25 kg in FGR with abnormal Doppler, 1.94 +/- 0.16 kg in FGR with normal Doppler, and 3.06 +/- 0.31 kg in the control group
